facts.text: Nigeria has an estimated population of 186 million.
Nigeria has the largest economy in Africa.
Nigeria has trading partners including China, India, the Netherlands, Spain, Brazil, and South Africa.
Nigeria's main exports are petroleum, petroleum products, cocoa, and rubber.
About 95 per cent of Nigeria's exports are petroleum.
Nigeria was hit quite hard when the price of oil fell in 2014.
Nigeria's imports include machinery, chemicals, transport equipment, manufactured goods, and food.
